prompts.flagstone: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production seamless square ground texture for a hand-painted fantasy RPG. Input image is an approved environment art direction board, STYLE AND MATERIAL QUALITY reference only. Create ONLY the requested ground material, viewed exactly vertically down, edge-to-edge orthographic flat texture, 1024x1024. No environment vignette, architecture, props, walls, paths, frames, grid, letters, numbers or watermark. No object silhouettes, distinct round medallions, prominent isolated marks or dark vignette. Every edge must wrap seamlessly, texture scale and detail density uniform across the image. Refined hand-painted stone-and-gouache craftsmanship like the reference; restrained natural color, low-contrast surface detail, believable tiny wear and diffuse crevices. Quiet even neutral ambient illumination, weak soft upper-left micro-shading only, no directional large cast shadows or baked warm light. Designed to sit beneath a detailed character, no high-frequency photographic/grain noise. Do not reproduce the nine-panel layout. Primary material request: Large old irregular rectangular grey limestone floor slabs at believable mixed sizes, 5 to 7 slabs across the tile (covering about 3.2 metres). Soft rounded worn edges, thin uneven grey-brown mortar joints, small chipped corners, faint natural mineral variation. Cool medium-light grey with warm-grey variation, tiny muted moss only deep in a few seams. Match the stone hall in the reference closely. No branches, no carving, no decorative symbol, no grass invading the slab centers. Avoid thick black grout or a rigid uniform checkerboard.
